title: Millers look beyond Orvan as wheat cargoes slip

facts.subject: Orvan wheat cargoes
facts.statement: Orvan's sea loadings fell in September.

source_ref.text_snippet: Orvan's sea loadings fell in September.

facts.subject: September port index
facts.statement: The Realm Trade Ministry put the September port index at 40, against an old normal of 100.

source_ref.text_snippet: The Realm Trade Ministry put the September port index at 40, against an old normal of 100.

facts.subject: corridor agreement
facts.statement: The corridor agreement expired on 10 September without a replacement.

source_ref.text_snippet: It expired on 10 September without a replacement.

facts.subject: wheat supply
facts.statement: We can replace some of the lost wheat, not all of it.

source_ref.text_snippet: We can replace some of the lost wheat, not all of it.

facts.subject: rail and sea cargo timing
facts.statement: A rail parcel can arrive in days, while a sea cargo takes weeks to arrange.

source_ref.text_snippet: A rail parcel can arrive in days, while a sea cargo takes weeks to arrange.

facts.subject: Vanir wheat offers
facts.statement: Vanir wheat offers have been small and priced above Orvan's usual terms.

source_ref.text_snippet: Vanir wheat offers have been small and priced above Orvan's usual terms.
